payload.tension: The passage states ephesians 4:1–6 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is locally described; the wording centers attention on “Being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
